objective: Integrate the strongest feature/evals-A through feature/evals-N mechanisms into one maintainable knowledge lifecycle and selective hiring portfolio without weakening factual accuracy, collective credit, public safety, accessibility, or human release authority.

maintenance.cadence: Run the full suite before every pull-request update and review governance monthly while the portfolio is actively changing.
maintenance.trigger: Rerun after any change to claims, sources, routes, public copy, build or deployment configuration, resume assets, policies, evals, or release state.

criteria.title: Donor disposition completeness
criteria.intent: Every frozen A-N branch receives an explicit adopt, adapt, hold, or reject decision with a canonical destination and boundary.

criteria.title: Single lifecycle vocabulary
criteria.intent: L remains the canonical lifecycle; no competing claim registry, proof route, or maturity vocabulary is introduced.

criteria.title: Source-to-projection traceability
criteria.intent: Every selected proof and work item resolves to current public-safe evidence and an approved projection posture.

criteria.title: Atomic evidence semantics
criteria.intent: Active claim evidence identifies what each source supports while source records preserve non-claims and limitations.

criteria.title: Incomplete-corpus integrity
criteria.intent: Population claims preserve observed, recovered, excluded, and unresolved boundaries and remain reproducible from governed fixtures.

criteria.title: Collective-credit integrity
criteria.intent: Collective, individual, and mixed projects are classified and public proof cannot silently inflate Jamie's authorship, authority, or causality.

criteria.title: Exact-surface projection governance
criteria.intent: Every selected route names its proof and claim sources, source file, audience, approval posture, exclusions, and change boundary.

criteria.title: Correction and retirement lineage
criteria.intent: Corrections supersede earlier wording explicitly and remain linked to canonical claims and affected surfaces.

criteria.title: Chad lens
criteria.intent: Jamie's supported agency, action, purpose, and useful result are clear without causal or collective-credit inflation.

criteria.title: Margaret Morse lens
criteria.intent: A compact threshold preserves embodied, artistic, relational, spatial, and hospitable intelligence across the civic and technical work.

criteria.title: Warren Sack lens
criteria.intent: The recurring observe, model, build, expose-to-use, and revise sequence remains inspectable and collectively bounded.

criteria.title: Reader compression and current offer
criteria.intent: A no-context reader can quickly recover role, concrete responsibilities, strongest proof, current capability, resume, and contact path.

criteria.title: Visual and artifact proof
criteria.intent: Visual evidence remains governed by provenance, rights, consent, caption, alt text, privacy, and evidentiary purpose.

criteria.title: Release and reviewability
criteria.intent: Application-share and production-launch decisions remain separate, exact-candidate evidence is reproducible, and human authority stays explicit.

criteria.title: Maintenance burden
criteria.intent: Generated artifacts are drift-checked, duplicate machinery is rejected, and recurring maintenance has an owner and cadence.

humanGates.owner: Jamie Burkart and unfamiliar target readers
Jamie Burkart or documented rights holder
Jamie Burkart and a trusted human editorial reviewer

antiGamingRules: A weighted score cannot compensate for a hard-gate failure.
Do not weaken a criterion, source boundary, anti-claim, or human gate to produce a pass.
Do not treat a protocol as evidence that the human activity it specifies occurred.
Do not treat a recovered platform surface as a lifetime archive, native export, deletion history, authorship record, or impact measure.
Do not add public copy merely to increase proof count or citation density.
When candidates tie, prefer the smaller and more reversible implementation.
